messages:
maya-peopleops: Quick alert 52 Oliver (SWE) says his spouse's embassy appointment got pushed to late June; he can't get visa stamping before June 10. Original start date June 1. Need options for payroll, benefits, and equipment shipping.

oliver-newhire: Sorry everyone 52 I have approved I-797 (COS) but I'm currently outside the US and need the consular stamp. I can do unpaid onboarding if that's acceptable.

immig-legal: If Oliver is outside the US without stamp, we cannot start payroll or have him perform paid work. Unpaid onboarding is OK, no client work. Contractor route is high-risk for COS cases; will provide risk note if requested.

payments: Benefits start is tied to payroll. If payroll delayed, health coverage will start on first paid cycle. We can reimburse relocation receipts early with approvals (typical turnaround 7-10 days).

ryan-manager: Team wants him onboard for async training. IT, can we ship a laptop to his country?

it-ops-bot: We can ship internationally with manager sign-off and signed asset acceptance. Expect 7-14 business days. Confirm customs and prohibited items.

maya-peopleops: Plan proposed: 1) Offer unpaid virtual onboarding starting June 1. 2) Hold payroll until entry/stamp. 3) Finance to expedite reimbursement on receipts. 4) Manager to approve laptop shipment if accepted. I'll email Oliver with checklist now.

oliver-newhire: Thanks Maya. I'll take unpaid onboarding and send shipping address + sign IT ack. I'll share appointment confirmation once booked.
